show.description: Alok Upadhyay, a noble elder brother, sacrifices everything to secure a bright future for his younger brother Rohan. But as Alok rises to power with the support of his devoted wife Anita and strong-willed daughter Aditi, Rohan, twisted by greed and fueled by his arrogant wife Diya, betrays the very family that gave him everything. A tale of sacrifice, ambition, and the tragic downfall of brotherhood.
